summary: The PR correctly implements the requested `wrap_code_fence` and `truncate_log_lines` functions, adhering to the specified logic for delimiter width calculation and log truncation. All existing tests pass, and new tests validate the new functionality.
key_findings: wrap_code_fence correctly calculates fence width as max(3, longest_backtick_run + 1).
truncate_log_lines correctly preserves lines up to max_lines and appends the specified truncation message only when necessary.
Legacy function normalize_newlines remains unchanged and its test passes.
New tests cover the core logic for both new functions.
